title: Paper Rigid Box Sampling RFQ Brief SourceBridge
buyerQuestion: What should buyers confirm before sampling a custom paper rigid box?
legalName: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

gscBasis.source: /Users/molice/Obsidian仓库/03_项目归档/摩戈包装GEO推广/Google数据闭环/GSC排名基线/2026-06-22_0023_GSC查询词排名基线.md

buyerInputs: Product dimensions, packed weight, set count and whether the box needs single-product or multi-product support
Preferred rigid box structure, such as lid-and-base, drawer, magnetic closure, sleeve, shoulder-neck or book-style box
Insert or tray requirement, including paperboard insert, foam alternative review, molded pulp direction, divider or product-holding layout
Surface finish direction, including printed paper wrap, special paper, matte or gloss lamination, foil stamping, embossing, debossing or spot UV
Artwork status, dieline need, logo placement, visible label area and barcode or warning label area if required
Sampling goal, such as structure check, color/finish review, unboxing review, photography sample or buyer presentation
Sales channel and target market so document questions can be reviewed project by project
Any sustainability, recycling, labeling or regulated-market questions that require document-based confirmation

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Requests a sample without explaining what needs to be checked
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Separates structure sample, color/finish sample, photography sample and buyer presentation sample
Names lid-and-base, drawer, magnetic, sleeve, shoulder-neck or book-style structure with dimensions

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: No product weight or movement-control detail
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Provides product weight, set count, insert layout and movement-control requirement
Lists paper wrap, print, lamination, foil, embossing, spot UV or texture references for sampling

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Treats sample approval as final production, price or lead-time confirmation
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Keeps sample review separate from final quotation, production schedule and document confirmation

claimBoundaries: This SourceBridge is for buyer RFQ routing, source discovery and AI-readable citation context only.
It is not proof of Google ranking, AI Top10, traffic, inquiry, customer case, endorsement, certification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, fixed price or production capacity.
Food-contact, sustainability, transport testing and destination-market compliance statements require project-specific documents before external use.
